Purpose in Action,
Impact for Generations

The year theme of the Rotaract Club of Dhaka Abani, Rotary Year 2026–27 — a community of young people in Dhaka turning service into lasting change.

Who We Are

The Rotaract Club of Dhaka Abani is a community-based Rotaract club sponsored by the Rotary Club of Dhaka Abani, part of Rotary International District 64, Bangladesh. We bring together young adults who want to lead community projects, build professional skills, and grow lasting friendships along the way.

From free medical camps to religious education drives and career guidance seminars for college students, our projects are planned and run by our own members — with mentorship from our sponsoring Rotary club.

  • Community ServiceFree medical camps & local outreach
  • Youth ServiceCareer guidance for college students
  • FellowshipRegular meetings & member events
  • Professional GrowthLeadership roles across the club

About the Club

A community-based Rotaract club in Dhaka, Bangladesh

Rotaract Club of Dhaka Abani is sponsored by the Rotary Club of Dhaka Abani, under Rotary International District 64. Our members are young professionals and students who share a commitment to service above self — the guiding motto of Rotary and Rotaract worldwide.

Each Rotary year, our club runs a calendar of community, professional, and fellowship projects — from medical camps and education drives to career guidance programs for college students — all planned and delivered by our own members, with guidance from our sponsoring Rotary club.

For Rotary Year 2026–27, our theme is “Purpose in Action, Impact for Generations” — a reminder that the service we do today is meant to outlast us.

Our Work

A few of our recent projects

Upcoming · November 2026 · Armed Police Battalion Public School and College

Rotaract Career Guidance Seminar

A joint Rotary–Rotaract youth development programme for second-year college students, featuring four interactive career sessions with experienced Rotarians, a keynote on building a career roadmap, a panel discussion, and an interactive Q&A.

31 July 2026 · Tongi, Gazipur

Free Medical Camp

Our very first project of Rotary Year 2026–27. Held at Maghdi Molla High School with free check-ups for local residents, run jointly with the Rotary Club of Dhaka Abani, an Interact club, and Rotaract Dhaka NextGen.

21 September 2026 · Jamiatun Nabawi Al Islamiya

Noor-E-Ilm

Qur’an and kitab distribution, a Qur’an tilawat competition, and a prize-giving ceremony — spreading the light of knowledge among young learners.

Ongoing

Regular Meetings

Our members meet regularly to plan projects, elect roles, and stay connected — sometimes with a skyline for company.

A Meeting Beyond the Four Walls

Fellowship, Outdoors

Not every meeting needs four walls. Some of our best conversations happen under open sky, among trees.
